name: @platform/entitlement
description: EntitlementGuard (Platform Kernel, ADR-0018/ADR-0027) — the enforcement point (PEP) that gates command execution on a tenant×feature entitlement decision. Fail-closed, deterministic, replay-safe, idempotent. The decision (PDP) is resolved by Licensing behind the EntitlementPort; the guard owns no business logic.
